phase_history.notes: Full spec provided by user: dedicated 2004-2010 uplifting/hard trance mid-bass synth. 3 osc + sub, unison w/ mono mode, Roland-style filter w/ feedback saturation, fast envelopes, 2 LFO, 6-slot matrix, saturation/EQ/transient, macros, FX chain, analyzer, keyboard strip.

Reuse audit done (.ideas/vaz-reuse-audit.md): OscBlock/Type-R/ADSR/LFO/ModMatrix/Biquad/FFT/Vaz FX engines all port from verified code. ROADMAP.md phases 0-9. Native JUCE GUI (custom LookAndFeel + MidiKeyboardComponent per spec, like TranceChords). Filter = Type-R (LP) + ZDF SVF (HP/BP).

Phase 1: MbOscillators.h — 3x VAZ OscBlock + sub (true bypass) + 8-voice unison (mono-unison rule) + sync/FM/ring + per-osc drift. 11 new Catch2 cases, all green 10/10 seeds. FM+ring alias fixed via band-limited (mip+1) modulator taps: ring -36 dB -> -89 dB, FM -38 dB -> -51 dB. Pulse waveshape mapping corrected vs TranceAcid (square = waveshape 0.5).

Phase 2: MbFilter.h hybrid filter. Type-R (bit-exact) LP24/LP12 + derived ZDF SVF HP12/BP12 w/ always-on tanh feedback sat (drive-matched). Measured calibration: Type-R corner 1.45x -> pre-scaled; passband +5.0/+2.8 dB gain align. 256-sample equal-power mode crossfade, all 12 ordered pairs click-free (<-60 dBFS HF gate). One cutoff law (modulatedCutoff, +-5 oct env). Slopes: LP24 -23.5, LP12 -12.8, HP12 +13.2 dB/oct; BP12 peak 998.6/1000. THD drive deltas: R 14.9 dB vs SVF 10.9 dB. 8 filter test cases green.

framework_selection.rationale: Spec mandates custom LookAndFeel, fixed one-panel layout, juce::MidiKeyboardComponent, sweet-spot arcs on knobs - native JUCE fits exactly (TranceChords precedent). No canvas/web requirement.
